item.title: Rust GCC Compiler Backend: Install rustc-codegen-gcc with One Command
item.description: rustc-codegen-gcc is now officially part of rustup nightly components. Linux users can now experience GCC-compiled Rust code with a single command. No more manual compilation, no more environment setup hassles—it's like giving Rust a new engine.

item.title: Rust Compiler Pipeline Refactor: 35% Faster Build Times, But There's a Catch
item.description: Our team's CI dropped from 42 minutes to 27 minutes just by upgrading the Rust compiler. This journey taught us one thing: performance optimization rewards those who measure, punishes those who guess.

item.title: Rust 1.90 Upgrade Crash Report: My Codebase Didn't Make It
